control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on P-9503 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during routine operation while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 6 February 2014 a hazard report was recorded on P-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
